catalog_decisions.rationale: Wave 0 publishes a static JSON registry first so every later read model, guardrail, and controller can consume the same loop ids and maturity vocabulary without waiting for a new service owner.

maturity_levels.meaning: Operators or developers must perform the next transition by hand.
maturity_levels.closure_evidence: Runbook or manual curl path only.

maturity_levels.meaning: Canonical API or store exists, but no durable worker or controller owns the transition.
maturity_levels.closure_evidence: Route tests or contract tests only.

maturity_levels.meaning: A cron or scheduler calls something periodically, but it does not reconcile desired and actual state.
An idempotent controller continuously compares desired state with actual state and repairs drift.
maturity_levels.closure_evidence: Controller tests, restart tests, drift repair proof, and metrics.

maturity_levels.meaning: The reconciled loop has runtime evidence under the target deployment mode, including liveness, recovery, and operator-visible truth.
maturity_levels.closure_evidence: EP4 or EP5 style evidence packet, replay or readback, and failure recovery drill.

truth_levels.meaning: A seed, fixture, static label, or example payload exists; this is never loop liveness proof.
The loop is represented in a durable catalog or registry but may not have a running scheduler or reconciler.
A scheduler or worker tick is observable, without proving drift repair.
A controller has demonstrated desired-vs-actual reconciliation, duplicate safety, restart behavior, and operator-visible truth.
The reconciled loop has target-environment runtime evidence with liveness, recovery, and readback.

trigger_model.race_policy: Source records feed distillation and do not directly compete with other loops.

desired_state.query: planned: list persona data requirements and connector policy candidates

actual_state.query: planned: list connector registrations, schedules, last fetch, and last push per required source

maturity.rationale: Connector registry and schedule APIs exist, but persona requirements do not auto-register connectors or guarantee scheduler workers.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate ticks must verify existing connector and schedule records without creating duplicates
controller_contract.restart_behavior: Reload durable controller state from SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH, refresh runtime identity with a new generation id, and refuse persisted state whose tenant or environment does not match this runtime.

seed_fixture.note: Seed data is not accepted as source liveness proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable source_ingestion loop id and target.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Persona requirement to connector and schedule reconciliation remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Target-environment proof follows reconciler and operator truth work.

trigger_model.race_policy: Distillation writes mutable draft heads only; promotion consumes immutable approved artifacts.

desired_state.query: planned: list normalized SourceRecord evidence not reflected in current StrategySpec draft heads

actual_state.query: planned: list draft heads and distillation job completion per source evidence cluster

maturity.rationale: Normalized source and strategy objects exist, but no durable event consumer owns source-to-draft updates.

controller_contract.desired_state_query: normalized SourceRecords from the source evidence repository
controller_contract.actual_state_query: distillation job queue metrics plus Registry terminal readback
controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate source events must converge on one draft update or no-op
controller_contract.restart_behavior: Reload durable controller state from DISTILLATION_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH and re-issue a fresh controller id; unacknowledged queue jobs are re-claimed after their lease expires.

seed_fixture.note: Seed strategy examples do not prove source-to-draft automation.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable strategy_distillation loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: The primary policy trigger is event-driven; catch-up scheduling is secondary.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Durable source-to-strategy worker proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Cross-loop operator drill follows reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: research task and experiment run stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Replication requires researcher, persona, or review decision before entering a queue.

desired_state.query: planned: list reviewed strategy specs requiring replication or scheduled revalidation

actual_state.query: planned: list queue state, latest run, and revalidation status per reviewed strategy

maturity.rationale: Research task and artifact APIs exist, but durable replication queue ownership and revalidation are incomplete.

controller_contract.desired_state_query: approved StrategySpec registry entries discovered from the distillation seed store
controller_contract.actual_state_query: alpha replication queue and revalidation worker metrics
controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate review events must not enqueue duplicate replication work
controller_contract.restart_behavior: Reload durable controller state from ALPHA_REPLICATION_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH; a missing state file starts a new controller identity and the durable replication queue is re-processed idempotently.

seed_fixture.note: Seed experiment records are not accepted as replication liveness.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable alpha_replication loop id and target.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Queue and revalidation controller proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Cross-loop operator evidence follows controller proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: teaching session and persona mutation gate stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Teaching results cannot affect persona behavior until evaluation and governance gates pass.

desired_state.query: planned: list teaching sessions waiting for preview, evaluation, or gated commit

actual_state.query: planned: list teaching workflow stage and persona-affecting commit status

maturity.rationale: Teaching routes exist, but async evaluation and persona mutation gates are not owned by a durable worker.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate preview or eval ticks must reuse the same stage record or no-op

seed_fixture.note: Teaching examples are not accepted as async evaluation liveness.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable persona_teaching loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: The policy trigger is user-driven with async workers, not a cron loop.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Async preview and evaluation worker proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Operator drill evidence follows reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: Agora interaction evidence and governed dataset stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Interaction evidence enters Observe or Learn datasets only and never directly mutates LEAN or running artifacts.

desired_state.query: planned: list captured interactions requiring dataset extraction, handoff creation, or learning-evidence routing

actual_state.query: planned: list extraction and handoff status for each interaction evidence record

maturity.rationale: Interaction capture exists, but dataset extraction and learning-evidence routing are not a governed background loop.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate interaction events must not duplicate training examples or handoffs

seed_fixture.note: Example Agora records are not accepted as extraction-loop proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable agora_interaction_evidence loop id and target.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Governed dataset extraction worker proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Operator drill evidence follows reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: policy learning proposal and shadow candidate stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Model updates do not affect running artifacts; shadow candidates require experiment, approval, and deployment gates.

desired_state.query: planned: list trace datasets due for imitation, shadow evaluation, or rapid eval

actual_state.query: planned: list latest imitation and shadow eval result per governed dataset

maturity.rationale: Policy-learning boundaries exist, but trace-to-dataset-to-eval-to-candidate flow is not scheduled or reconciled.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate scheduled ticks must not create duplicate candidates for the same dataset version

seed_fixture.note: Static traces are not accepted as scheduled imitation proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable human_imitation_shadow_evaluation loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: Batch scheduler proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Operator drill evidence follows scheduled and reconciled proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: consult request, memo, transcript, and handoff stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Consultation is pre-LEAN advisory or review-bound and does not directly trigger deploy.

desired_state.query: planned: list consult requests waiting for participants, memo generation, or governance handoff

actual_state.query: planned: list workflow stage and handoff consumption status per consult request

maturity.rationale: Consultation state, transcript, memo, and outbox stores exist, but workflow execution and handoff consumption are not durable.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate workflow events must not duplicate participant work or handoffs

seed_fixture.note: Example consult records are not accepted as workflow execution proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable consultation loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: The primary trigger is on-demand event-driven.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Durable committee and red-team workflow proof remains follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Operator drill evidence follows reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: approval, deployment plan, saga, and runtime binding stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Deployment consumes immutable approved artifact snapshots only.

desired_state.query: planned: list approved deployment plans requiring saga dispatch into runtime-manager

actual_state.query: planned: list saga progress, runtime binding status, and retry or DLQ reason per deployment plan

maturity.rationale: Approval, deployment plan, saga models, and runtime-manager authority exist, but no always-on saga dispatcher closes plan-to-binding feedback.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate outbox events must not create duplicate runtime bindings

seed_fixture.note: Seed deployment plans are not accepted as saga dispatch proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable promotion_deployment loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: The policy trigger is explicit command-driven async saga.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Deployment saga dispatcher, runtime-manager adapter, feedback, and truth split remain follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Target-environment evidence follows reconciled saga and runtime fleet proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: runtime binding and supervised runtime worker stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Execution is isolated from persona discussion, governance approval, learning, and artifact synthesis paths.

sources: active paper and canary RuntimeBinding records
desired_state.query: planned: list active runtime bindings and policy envelopes from runtime-manager

actual_state.query: planned: list worker, session, heartbeat, and signal isolation status per active binding

maturity.rationale: Runtime execution has historical governed-paper evidence, but active bindings are not guaranteed to reconcile into exactly one supervised worker with restart, stop, and signal isolation.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate fleet ticks must converge to exactly one worker per active binding

seed_fixture.note: Runtime fixtures do not prove currently supervised workers.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable capital_pool_execution loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: This is the only continuous loop in the L1 trigger policy.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Runtime fleet desired-state, exactly-one-worker reconciliation, session reaping, signal isolation, and evidence remain follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Historical paper evidence exists, but it does not raise current maturity without active reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: telemetry, drift report, incident, and reconciliation stores

trigger_model.race_policy: Reconciliation does not affect running runtime; it produces analysis and incident outcomes.

desired_state.query: planned: list bindings and telemetry streams due for reconciliation or incident-triggered analysis

actual_state.query: planned: list latest telemetry, reconciliation, drift report, and incident linkage per binding/runtime

maturity.rationale: Telemetry ingest is mature, but reconciliation, drift report, incident creation, postmortem, and evolution handoff are not an automatic end-to-end chain.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate telemetry and duplicate reconciliation ticks must not duplicate incidents

seed_fixture.note: Telemetry fixtures are not accepted as reconciliation-loop proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable telemetry_reconciliation loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: Scheduled reconciliation worker proof remains follow-up work.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Readiness, scheduled reconciliation, incident listener, drift-to-incident, and replay evidence remain follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Operator replay evidence follows reconciler proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: EvolutionDecision and governed action dispatch stores

trigger_model.race_policy: One active EvolutionDecision per target; new triggers merge or wait under cooldown policy.

desired_state.query: planned: list resolved incidents, postmortems, and thresholds requiring missing evolution proposals or dispatch

actual_state.query: planned: list proposed, reviewed, approved, dispatched, and executed evolution stages per target

maturity.rationale: Evolution decision lifecycle exists, but threshold sweeps, incident/postmortem proposal generation, and approved-action dispatch are incomplete.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate postmortem or sweep ticks must converge to one active decision per target

seed_fixture.note: Seed evolution decisions are not accepted as proposal-loop proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable evolution loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: Daily sweep proof remains follow-up work.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Incident-to-postmortem, postmortem-to-proposal, sweep, dispatch, and rollback follow-through proof remain follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Target evidence follows governed dispatcher and operator drill proof.

owner.authoritative_write_owner: BFF health metrics, telemetry, and incident signal stores

trigger_model.race_policy: BFF degraded mode does not affect active runtimes.

desired_state.query: planned: list required downstream probes, service-level objectives, and expected operator truth projections

actual_state.query: planned: list controller health, last success, last failure, downstream status, and evidence per loop

maturity.rationale: BFF aggregates health and read models, but no continuous monitor writes authoritative telemetry and incident signals for operator truth.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate probes must dedupe telemetry and incident signals by target and window

seed_fixture.note: Panel fixtures are not accepted as downstream health proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog defines the stable bff_health_monitoring loop id and target.

scheduled_tick.note: Continuous probe worker evidence remains follow-up work.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Loop health read model, downstream monitor, truth labeling, and operator drills remain follow-up work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Cross-loop operator drills are the target proof path.

composite_overlays.name: Per-Persona OODA

policy_ref.document: Pantheon_總索引版系統分析文件.md

owner.authoritative_write_owner: persona schedule registry, OpenClaw cron run records, and OODA packet store

trigger_model.race_policy: Schedules and packets converge by persona and run identity; Act remains proposal-only in the pre-LEAN control plane and never calls LEAN or a broker directly.

sources: Pantheon_總索引版系統分析文件.md#6.4
desired_state.query: planned: list every eligible persona and its required Observe, Orient, Decide, Act-proposal, and Learn schedule

sources: OpenClaw persona cron registrations and run records
persona schedule and packet health records
actual_state.query: planned: list schedule identity, last terminal cron run, persisted OODA packet, orphan state, and controller health per eligible persona

maturity.rationale: Cron registration, run, and packet contracts exist, but archive completion and historical smoke do not prove a current idempotent schedule reconciler, orphan repair, restart recovery, or controller health.

controller_contract.duplicate_event_policy: planned: duplicate registration and cron completion events converge on one schedule and one packet per cron run identity

seed_fixture.note: Static personas, synthetic packets, and fixture cron runs are not accepted as OODA liveness proof.

registry_metadata.note: This catalog registers per_persona_ooda as a composite overlay without changing the twelve-loop L1 inventory.

scheduled_tick.note: Archived cron-to-packet task evidence is historical reference only and cannot raise current maturity or liveness.

reconciled_live_proof.note: Current schedule reconciliation, orphan repair, duplicate safety, restart recovery, and controller truth remain product remediation work.

proven_live_evidence.note: Target-dev current controller evidence and restart/readback proof remain required.

notes: This overlay composes pre-LEAN research, interaction, consultation, governance, telemetry, and learning loops; it excludes capital_pool_execution because persona Act is proposal-only and excludes bff_health_monitoring because platform health is not a persona decision stage.
Capital Pool Execution remains the only continuously resident execution loop.
